anya: Morning — quick async check from me (what I did / blockers / today)
anya: Did: exported hf checkpoint -> tinyq, ran smoke quant pass, pushed artifacts to `staging/models/llama2-smallq/2026-03-17`
anya: Blockers: seeing ~1.2% regression on spanish promptset (odd tokenization differences), and KV-cache eviction when seq_len > 2048 that causes repeated context drops
anya: Today: debug tokenizer mismatch, run full regression eval, open CR for tinyq loader if needed. pinging for quick reviews.
jake: Re: tokenization — I noticed a similar diff last night. Can you paste a short example input + token ids?
maria: I can try to repro locally. From previous cases it was `do_lower_case` mismatch between tokenizers. Try toggling that first.
kevin: I glanced at the diff in the export script — left a couple comments on edge-case normalization in CR #3421. Also suggest adding a tiny unit test for special characters.
anya: thx. Running a targeted eval now (smoke -> then full):
anya: ```
python tools/eval.py --model=staging/llama2-smallq:2026-03-17 --promptset=spanish-context --batch=32 --seq_len=4096 --samples=500
```
ops-bot: Evaluation job queued: job_id=eval-20260317-88, estimated time ~18m. Logs at https://ci.redwood/demo-evals/eval-20260317-88
maria: If you want faster feedback, run `--samples=50 --quick=True` first so we don't wait on the full sweep.
jake: I added a synthetic prompt (accented chars + dates) to the promptset in the repo — should help reproduce tokenization. pinged @kevin for regression gate comments.
anya: Quick update — toggled `do_lower_case=False` and the 1.2% gap mostly disappears on the smoke run. KV-cache eviction still repros when we simulate very long prefix ( > 4096 ). Filing issue: https://issues.redwood/INF-1286 with repro steps.
kevin: Good catch on the tokenizer flag. For the KV issue, can you attach a short repro trace (kv sizes + timestamps) to the ticket? I'll try to allocate a couple of GPU cycles to reproduce later today.
anya: Will attach logs + minimal repro snippet. If anyone can eyeball the CR (#3421) quickly, would appreciate it — mostly around tinyq loader boundary checks.
maria: Happy to review after lunch. If you want, I can also sanity-run the eval on a different infra zone to rule out infra-specific behavior. :thumbsup:
jake: +1.
anya: OK thanks team — will post results here when full eval completes or if I hit new blockers.
